Sparelimit is provided as is, without warranty of any kind. It may contain errors, stop working, or read a log format wrongly when another tool changes it.

## The numbers are not advice or a bill

Figures are labelled exact, derived or estimated. Dollars are what the same usage would cost at public list prices, not what you were charged. A counted saving is not proof that a warning caused it. Nothing here is financial, legal or professional advice. Check anything you rely on against your provider's own records.

## It can act in your tools

If you install its hooks, Sparelimit can show warnings and can stop an action your AI tool is about to take, according to the thresholds in force. You decide whether to install it and which settings to use. Keep your own backups. Review any command or file it writes before you rely on it.

## Your responsibility for your data

The logs it reads can hold other people's information, a client's or an employer's. Use it only on data you are allowed to process, and read anything before you share it.
